mapper.insert: INSERT INTO _inquiry (member_id, member_name, title, content, created_at, istatus, email, phone) VALUES (#{member_id}, #{member_name}, #{title}, #{content}, now(), #{istatus}, #{email}, #{phone})

INSERT INTO _inquiry_file (bno, originalName, storedName, filePath, fileType, uploadDate, thumbnailPath) VALUES (#{bno}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{uploadDate}, #{thumbnailPath})
